title: Runner host action
description: One action a person approves for one enrolled runner to carry out on its host: the action's dotted id from the catalog, the runner that runs it, its parameters (typed per action) and what it does in one plain sentence. It travels inside a signed approval for a pinned run: the approval names this schema, carries the action as its canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace), pins the SHA-256 of that JSON, and the action's runner_id is the run's own. Integers and strings only, so the canonical JSON is the same in every language. The object and every params object are closed: an action can do only what its params say. Catalog: k8s.delete-failed-pods (params.namespace; absent means every namespace). Draft line: it may still be corrected.

action.description: The action's id from the catalog: lower-case dotted words, for example k8s.delete-failed-pods.

runner_id.description: The enrolled runner that runs it: rnr_ and a ULID, the same as the run's runner_id.

params.description: The action's parameters; their shape is the action's (see the catalog below).

effect.description: What it does, one plain sentence a person reads before approving, for example: Deletes every failed pod in namespace example.

k8s-delete-failed-pods.description: k8s.delete-failed-pods: delete the pods in phase Failed. namespace names one namespace; absent, every namespace.

namespace.description: A Kubernetes namespace name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63.
